log: STOP INTEGRATING TIME -- diagonalise once, then marks and instants are nearly free
Sphere tiling made one static solve cheaper but did nothing about 4D, whose cost is the
NUMBER of solves: ~10^9 steps per microsecond times ~350M marks. Cheaper steps cannot fix
needing a billion of them. But the system is LINEAR, and a linear system is diagonalised,
not integrated: each mode evolves in closed form, so any instant is an expression. The
eigenbasis belongs to the STRUCTURE, so it is computed once and every mark reuses it.
The only real question is HOW MANY MODES, and that is measured here against the exact field.
